claim_boundary: ideal fixed-label MDL aperture; not a finite codec or target result

quantizer.scale: FP64 RMS rounded to IEEE binary16 LE; decoded binary16 value drives thresholds and reconstruction

common_latents.binary: per-role modal Gray-code bitplane across experts; lower-symbol tie; charged one-bit plane selector per role
common_latents.quaternary: per-role modal four-level label across experts; lower-symbol tie
common_latents.family_selection: binary versus quaternary is source-selected; one family-selector bit is charged in either two-part branch

decision.first_gate: favorable marginal ideal bits minus private conditional ideal bits, with U/model temporarily free
decision.first_gate_failure: hard kill before controls or finite-coder work

controls.kind: independent deterministic affine coordinate permutations per expert and role

physical_envelope.layout: [global header + raw U + common model][private expert i]
physical_envelope.strict_read_amplification: max(page-amortized physical, nonpadding decodable) < 2 for every expert
physical_envelope.feasible_rate_rule: a family is read-eligible only when at least one frozen endpoint in {2.15,2.5} has status IDEAL_CAPACITY_ONLY_NOT_AN_EMITTED_CODEC, capacity_ok=true, and strictly_below_2x=true; scientific controls and promotion use only read-eligible families
physical_envelope.warning: capacity/read envelope only; no finite entropy coder is implemented

universality: core accepts E in [2,256] and any positive legal SwiGLU d_ff,d_model; panel plugin is evaluation-only
